rates.sourceNote: Updated from Directline Motor Insurance Terms 2025 (Underwriter-Binder, approved 11 Jan 2025). Motor Private, Commercial Own Goods, Commercial General Cartage, and Institutional comprehensive/TPO figures corrected against this document - the prior version's Motor Private comprehensive rate and all three commercial comprehensive rates were placeholder/stale figures well above the real published rates. Real data found but NOT modeled here (no matching schema field/vehicleUse class exists in this engine): Institutional TPO is banded by passenger count (below 6 pax 8,500 / 7-25 pax 15,000+PLL@500 / above 25 pax 10,000+PLL@500) rather than one flat figure - the existing flat 15,000 approximates the 7-25 pax tier only. Passenger Legal Liability (PLL@500) applies to Institutional/PSV/Chauffeur-driven classes. Separate PSV classes not modeled at all: Motor Cycle Private (TPO 3,194) and PSV/Boda Boda (TPO 3,651), PSV Taxi/Tuk Tuk (10,000+PLL), App-hailing Cabs Uber/Bolt/Faras (12,500-15,000+PLL by pax tier), Chauffeur-driven/Tour Vans (7,500-15,000+PLL by pax tier), PSV Matatu (7-35 pax, full seating-capacity TPO table attached separately), PSV Bus (above 35 pax), Motor Special Type (Agricultural/Forestry 3.5%, Engineering 3.5%, Rescue vehicles 4%+PLL), Tankers & Trailers - Petroleum/LPG (comprehensive only, 9% min 100,000, max vehicle age 10 years vs the standard 15).
